ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and send the driver's account to Ryde for review of the arrival-button tap made outside the pickup radius + flag_account
ruling.reasoning: NS-0 routes this dispute: the driver cancelled a completed-booking trip and claimed a rider no-show, so NS-1/NS-2 govern whether the $6.61 shown on the fare record [F6] stands [F3]. The trace settles the elements: NS-1 (i) is met by the driver_tap at 12:06:15 [F5], but NS-1 (ii) fails because at the moment of that tap the driver was 600 m from the pickup point and never came closer than 599 m [F5][F1], and NS-1 (iii) fails because he spent 0 s inside the 200 m radius after tapping [F5]. Under NS-1 all three conditions must hold together, and a wait served 600 m away [F2] is not a wait at the pickup point, so NS-1 is not satisfied and NS-2 requires the fee to be refunded in full.

rejected_claims.reason: The finding does not rest on the rider's chat message or profile: the driver's statement at 12:06 that he was already at the pickup point [F8] and the rider's reply that no car was there [F9] are statements, and profile facts may never decide a case [F16]; the refund rests solely on the GPS and timeline records [F1][F4][F5] under NS-2.

The account flag is correct but on NS-2's own trigger (the tap made while outside the pickup radius, [F5][F1]) which is settled by the trace; RD-6 does not apply here, because it requires an upheld route-deviation finding under RD-1/RD-2 and the profile shows route: 0, no-show: 1 [F17].

The 3 min 30 s stationary period from 12:05:55 to 12:09:25 [F2] cannot satisfy NS-1 (iii), which requires the continuous wait to be served at the pickup point; the whole period was spent 600 m away [F2] and the driver was never inside 200 m after the tap [F5].

The driver's post-trip statement that he waited at the pickup [F12] is contradicted by the GPS (closest approach 599 m [F1]) and the timeline (tap 600 m out, 0 s inside the radius afterwards [F5]), and system records override statements under NS-1/NS-2.

The driver's long tenure and rating [F17] cannot decide or mitigate the NS-1 conditions, which fail on the measured records [F1][F2][F5] under NS-2, and the rider's profile [F16] is likewise never evidence of a no-show.

actions.detail: account action is never automatic; queued for Ryde review

what_would_change: Had NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both held ((ii) within 200 m of pickup AT THE MOMENT of the arrival confirmation; (iii) stayed at the pickup more than 3 min after the arrival confirmation, until cancelling (NS-1 default: more than 3 min)), the fee would stand and no refund would be due.
